context_content_data.rationale: Directly and clearly addresses the prompt by stating immediate purpose and describing post-HSC medical and university admission preparation.
context_content_data.evidence: In your letter you wanted to know about my future plan after HSC. In this letter, I'm going to discribe my plan.

structure_format_brevity.rationale: Includes all essential layout components of an informal letter (Date, Address, Salutation, Body, Complimentary Close, Signature, and Envelope) in correct sequence.

language_mechanics.rationale: Shows multiple lexical and punctuation slips ('discribe', 'addmission', 'litte', 'students dream', 'Your ever') which prevents awarding the mechanics mark.
language_mechanics.evidence: As you know I wanted to become a doctor from the very litte. So I will prepare myself for medical exam.

originality_comparisons_paraphrase.rationale: Presents an authentic and pragmatic perspective on having a backup admission plan rather than relying on a rigid memorized template.
originality_comparisons_paraphrase.evidence: Since many students dream is to become a doctor, they all can't become doctor. Losing hope of life after that is a foolish mindset.

frequent_errors: Layout/grammar inaccuracies ('Your ever' instead of 'Yours ever', omitted possessive apostrophe in 'students dream')
positive_aspects: Complete 6-part informal letter layout including sender/receiver envelope address boxes
Authentic and mature personal reflection on future academic plans

feedback_summary: The candidate has produced a fully structured informal letter with clear purpose and authentic content concerning post-HSC admission plans. Minor spelling and grammatical slips keep the script at the lower end of Band 4.
